environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No API gateway in front. The application listens on port 8080 and is directly reachable. DNS resolution is performed by the application process using the system resolver (VPC DNS at 169.254.169.253). No egress filtering is applied to the instance's security group (all outbound traffic allowed). The internal metadata endpoint is bound to the same listener.
